Elaine (AE): Hey team — new POC with NovaHealth. Use case: clinical note summarization + risk-label classification for triage. Customer asks for a short, prescriptive runbook so they can sign off on acceptance criteria and costs. I sketched targets below, need engineering + ops to confirm blockers and estimates.

Elaine (AE): POC scope (2 weeks): week 1 = bench & model selection; week 2 = integration with sample traffic + acceptance run. Inputs: 300k tokens/day sim traffic, average input length 600 tokens, typical bot requests are single-turn.

Elaine (AE): Proposed success criteria: p95 latency <= 200ms (in-region), classification F1 >= 0.88 on the supplied eval set, end-to-end cost <= $1,200/day at 300k tokens. Acceptance requires reproducible eval harness and logs for 2 consecutive days.

Mike (PSE): Quick Q on pricing — is the cost target assuming hosted API or Dedicated? Also, do they need KMS + VPC? That changes burn a lot.

Elaine (AE): They prefer hosted first but want a path to Dedicated later. Security asks: customer will require KMS + audit logs; VPC peering is likely but maybe not for POC.

Sanjay (ML Eng): For latency/COST: which model families are we allowed to propose? If we use a quantized 13B we can hit cost targets but latency might be borderline. Need seq-len distribution: you said avg input 600 tokens + we generate ~80 tokens.

Elaine (AE): Yes, 600 in / 80 out is what they expect. We can propose 7B/13B/70B variants. Customer wants quality comparable to SOTA summarizers — F1 target above.

Taylor (SRE): Re: p95 200ms — that's tight for 13B on shared hosted unless we do dedicated pools or aggressive batching/KV caching. Also consider cold-starts and concurrency. What's expected concurrency?

Elaine (AE): Concurrency peak ~40 req/s, steady ~8 req/s. They need graceful degradation and fallback to a smaller model if capacity constrained.

Sanjay (ML Eng): Plan: run perf matrix across models with real seq dist. Eval harness will be open-source-style: holdout of 2k notes + labeled risk tags. I'll run quality + latency sweep:

Sanjay (ML Eng): ```
# eval-driver (pseudo)
for model in [redwood-7b, redwood-13b-q, redwood-70b-qat]:
  run_latency_benchmark(model, inputs=sample_2k)
  compute_f1(model, gold_labels)
```

Sanjay (ML Eng): I expect 13b-quant to be the sweet spot: ~150-250ms p95 on dedicated, F1 ~0.88-0.91. On hosted shared it may exceed 250ms p95.

Mike (PSE): Ballpark cost if hosted: ~ $0.0009 per token for 13b-q -> translates to ~ $270/day for 300k tokens (inference only) but memory footprints / concurrency add infra multipliers — call it $400-600/day. Dedicated reserved would be higher fixed commit but lower unit cost at scale.

Jess (Ops): Ops blockers: KMS integration timeline (2–3 days for key exchange + policy), VPC peering lead time (security review ~1 week), and we need an approved PCI/PHI flow for sample data. For POC we can use de-identified notes under NDA.

Taylor (SRE): Also add rate-limit + burst policy in the runbook. If they spike to 40/s we need autoscale headroom or a fallback model routing. I'll draft a fallback routing policy: primary=redwood-13b-q, fallback=redwood-7b.

deploy-bot: provisioning started for test-pool: pool-id p-az3-992. Logs: https://ci.redwood/p/az3-992/logs (provision step 1/4) :gear:

Elaine (AE): Perfect. Open items for sign-off:
- S1: Confirm model family to test (Sanjay)
- S2: Confirm hosting mode + preliminary burn estimate (Mike)
- S3: KMS + VPC minimal checklist for POC (Jess)
- S4: SRE fallback + autoscale policy draft (Taylor)
- S5: Eval harness + acceptance script (Sanjay)

Elaine (AE): Proposed timeline: start next Monday; Mid-POC sync Wed midday; Final acceptance Fri end-of-day (2-week window compressed if they approve).

Mike (PSE): I'll send a short hosted vs dedicated cost note by EOD with a commit-level estimate for Dedicated reserve vs pay-as-you-go.

Sanjay (ML Eng): I'll attach the eval script and a small sample in the onboarding doc by tomorrow. Need access to their gold labels (S3 link) and a minimal API key.

Jess (Ops): I'll start KMS paperwork and block VPC review on Wed. For POC we'll accept de-identified data under the NDA.

Taylor (SRE): Drafting fallback + autoscale now, will post recommended pooling config and p95 SLO adjustments (suggest p95 target be soft for hosted).

Elaine (AE): Thanks — once we have S1-S4 we can finalize the runbook and give NovaHealth the acceptance checklist. I'll post a ready-to-sign summary for legal once pricing landed. :thumbsup:

Elaine (AE): FYI for the thread title in our notes: "NovaHealth POC — triage summarization: SLAs, burn, acceptance" (not a Slack title, just for internal doc naming).
